acceptance_checks: PR changes to .shiki/gha, .shiki/cca, CCA verdict files, or MergeGate result files are blocked.
MergeGate refreshes live GitHub PR state immediately before policy evaluation.
MergeGate enforces PR headRefOid freshness against the checked-out head.
MergeGate compares protected .shiki state against base-branch .shiki state.
Unrelated task, goal, ledger, lock, and repair mutations are blocked.
Focused regression tests cover runtime evidence, task/goal, ledger, lock, live state, and workflow hygiene behavior.
Docs explain runtime evidence and PR-mutated mirror trust boundaries.
P0.4.6 and P0.4.7 can be checked after merge and mirror reconciliation.
non_goals: Do not implement P0.4.8 full adversarial forged-evidence regression suite.
Do not implement P1.3 architecture split.
Do not add a new database, external storage, reviewer bot, or GitHub App.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge approval semantics except for path hygiene.
Do not change Guardian approval policy, branch protection payload, CODEOWNERS ownership, T-0034 ID behavior, or T-0035 lock matcher semantics.
scope: Close Goal #30 P0.4.6 and P0.4.7 by protecting workflow runtime evidence and protected .shiki mirror state from untrusted PR mutation, and by making MergeGate policy refresh live GitHub PR state before evaluation.
title: Harden evidence against untrusted PR mutation and verify live GitHub state
